description: This PHP source file defines a class 'JobCategoryMenuConfigurator' that implements menu configuration for the 'JobCategory' screen within the OrangeHRM application. It implements an interface 'MenuConfigurator' and uses a trait 'ModuleScreenHelperTrait' to override the current screen.

classes.name: JobCategoryMenuConfigurator
